name: XlListConflict
description: Specifies the conflict resolution options for updating a list on a Microsoft SharePoint Foundation site with the changes made to a list in a Microsoft Excel worksheet.

constants.name: xlListConflictDialog
constants.description: Display a dialog box that allows the user to choose how to resolve conflicts.

constants.name: xlListConflictRetryAllConflicts
constants.description: Overwrite the version of the data stored on the SharePoint site.

constants.name: xlListConflictDiscardAllConflicts
constants.description: Accept the version of the data stored on the SharePoint site.

constants.name: xlListConflictError
constants.description: Raise an error if a conflict occurs.
